ACCELERATOR ONLY -- fires the feeder chain promptly on the INF spine completion sentinel (opal-data-inf gold/meta/pipeline-complete.json ObjectCreated), covering the measured days whose input lands after the 13:30Z floor. The GUARANTEE is aws_scheduler_schedule.mdpf_feeder_backstop; this rule must never be the sole trigger. Targets the trigger Lambda, NOT the dispatch, so the input pre-check cannot be bypassed.
values.name: mdpf-feeder-accelerator

values.alarm_description: mdpf-daily-trigger DLQ has >= 1 message: an EventBridge -> Lambda invocation failed (the daily MDPF chain did not start). Inspect the DLQ + Lambda logs; re-dispatch manually after fixing.
wsb-49f-model-aua-daily FAILED (roster under-coverage / vendor / landing-guard raise). The 49F model-AUA feed did not land today.
wsd-49f-partner-held-etf-daily FAILED (zero-held CUSIP-regression gate / rps-after-as_of gate / landing raise). The partner_held_etf feed did not land today.

values.description: MDPF feeder chain BACKSTOP -- the GUARANTEE half of backstop+accelerator; this schedule's absence was the TO-3 K3 @120a822241 regression. Fires mdpf-feeder-trigger, which input-pre-checks and logs NOT-YET without writing if the partition has not landed. 12:52Z derived from the measured INF/Eclipse frontier vs the 13:30Z floor (see feeder-trigger.tf header). Never remove without a replacement trigger in the same act.
values.name: mdpf-feeder-backstop-daily
